documents.unit: Center for Teaching Excellence and Innovation
documents.title: Your Classroom Faculty Guide to AI
documents.summary: A teaching-center page advising Rush faculty on AI. It tells them to set their own expectations, require an AI Use Disclosure and citations, redesign assessments, and not rely on detectors, and it welcomes faculty use of AI. It sets no student-wide rule.
documents.stance_why: The page sets no ban or permission itself; it says faculty should 'Set clear expectations for your students on whether and how they can use AI sources' and may 'allow it only for certain purposes', which hands the decision to instructors, so delegates.
